author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am not touching the containerization layer. It works, and I am not going to risk destabilizing the pipeline for a shadow run. If we need to move forward with the new model, you can take the hit on the rest of the chain. I will accept the current hands on setup staying exactly as it is today, provided you handle the integration work elsewhere. I am not absorbing that risk into my infrastructure. Keep the containers manual and I will keep the deployment stable. That is the trade I am willing to make to protect the live forecast.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the current manual setup and forgo improvements to protect stability, in exchange for offloading integration risks to another party.
